description: An extensionId one octet longer than the accepted maximum pushes the encoded line to 1048577 octets, one over IPC_MAX_LINE_BYTES, and is refused as line-too-long — the one reason measured after serialization rather than during member validation. extensionId is generated (repeat) rather than inlined, so this case costs a few lines rather than a megabyte of literal characters — mirrors docs/spec/conformance/v1/framing/cases/frame-one-octet-over-limit.json's repeat descriptor for the identical IPC_MAX_LINE_BYTES limit. Paired with line-at-limit-accepted.json, which uses the same descriptor one octet shorter and is accepted — together they pin that the check is strictly greater-than, not greater-than-or-equal.
